Question: How do I reset my Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra to factory settings?
Answer: Go to Settings → General Management → Reset → Factory Data Reset. Back up your data first using Samsung Cloud or Smart Switch. This will also erase your S Pen data and all registered fingerprints.

Question: How do I fix WiFi disconnecting on my Samsung Galaxy A15?
Answer: Go to Settings → Connections → WiFi → tap and hold your network → Forget. Then reconnect. Also go to Settings → Battery → Background usage limits and make sure WiFi is not being restricted. If issue persists after One UI update try Settings → General Management → Reset → Reset Network Settings.

Question: My Samsung Neo QLED TV has no picture but has sound — what do I do?
Answer: First try Settings → Support → Self Diagnosis → Picture Test. If that fails press and hold the power button on the TV (not remote) for 10 seconds to cold reboot. Check HDMI cables and connected devices. If black screen persists this may be a backlight issue requiring Samsung engineer visit — contact 1-800-SAMSUNG.

Question: How do I fix my Samsung OLED TV remote not responding?
Answer: Replace batteries with fresh AA batteries. Remove batteries and press any button 5 times to discharge. Re-pair remote by holding Return and Play/Pause buttons together for 3 seconds until remote indicator blinks. If SmartThings app is available use it as backup remote.

Question: My Samsung Bespoke AI Double Door fridge is not cooling — what should I check?
Answer: Check that the temperature is set correctly — recommended is 3°C for fridge and -18°C for freezer. Ensure the door seals are clean and sealing properly. Check that vents inside are not blocked by food items. If the display shows an error code note it down and contact Samsung Care. For complete cooling failure contact 1-800-SAMSUNG for engineer visit.

Question: Why is water leaking from the bottom of my Samsung refrigerator?
Answer: Water leaking from bottom is usually caused by a blocked defrost drain. Locate the drain hole at the back of the freezer compartment and clear any ice blockage using warm water. Also check the water supply line connection at back of fridge if you have a water dispenser. If leaking continues contact Samsung Care for engineer visit.

Question: How do I connect my Samsung Bespoke AI WindFree AC to SmartThings?
Answer: Download the SmartThings app on your phone. Turn on the AC and press and hold the WiFi button on the remote for 3 seconds. In SmartThings tap Add Device → Samsung → Air Conditioner → follow setup wizard. Ensure your phone and AC are on the same 2.4GHz WiFi network during setup.

Question: What should I do if my Samsung AC is not cooling properly?
Answer: Check that the air filter is clean — remove and wash every 2 weeks. Ensure all doors and windows are closed. Set mode to Cool and temperature to 24°C. Check that no objects are blocking the indoor or outdoor unit. If the outdoor compressor is not running contact Samsung Care on 1-800-SAMSUNG for refrigerant check.

Question: What is Samsung's warranty policy for home appliances?
Answer: Samsung provides a 12-month comprehensive warranty on all home appliances including TVs, refrigerators, and air conditioners from date of purchase. The compressor on refrigerators and ACs carries a 10-year warranty. Extended warranty is available through Samsung Care+. Original proof of purchase is required for all claims.

Question: How do I register my Samsung product for warranty?
Answer: Visit account.samsung.com and sign in to your Samsung account. Go to My Products → Register Product. Enter your model number and serial number found on the label at back or bottom of the product. Keep your purchase invoice safe as it is required for warranty claims.
